title: Normalization comparison objects on the isomorphism locus
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring, ℓ any natural number, ν:X′→X a finite morphism of schemes, and V an open of X such that ν restricted over V is an isomorphism. Let j:U→X and j′:U′→X′ be open immersions with ν′:U′→U giving a Cartesian square j′ν = ν′j. Set R = Λ/(ℓ). Then V^*(j_! R_U) and V^*(ν_*j′_!R_U′) are isomorphic as Λ-module sheaves, using inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], extension by zero [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero], and direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. No comparison morphism is specified.

proof.text: Form W = ν⁻¹(V) and T = U ×_X V. Finite base change identifies restriction of ν_*j′_!R with pushforward along ν_V of the restriction of j′_!R to W. Base change for extension by zero identifies the latter with extension by zero on U′ ×_X V.

The Cartesian square and the isomorphism ν_V identify U′ ×_X V with T and identify the two open immersions and constant coefficients. Constant sheaf pullback preserves R. Pushforward along the isomorphism ν_V yields j_T!R; open base change also identifies the restricted source with j_T!R. Compose these isomorphisms. The argument holds for empty opens and zero R, and does not need density or finiteness of R.
